chapter: Out of Time: from the entry walkway onto a passing platform (matrix C21-01)
note: tru.exe under Wine (2026-11-20, wine-ref): after 320_hel_boss she stands on the entry walkway at (-8143, 793, 4321) as in ours; the stones 8368-8370 circle at radius 4924-5025 (origin z 4442-4462, as ours) at 13.8 degrees a second; standing 58 back from the walkway's end, Up + Jump as stone 8368 came past at 159 degrees, she left the floor 0.07-0.11 s after the press (~25 units on), flew aimed at 2430 units/s and caught the stone's ledge near its corner (hang root 490 under the ledge loop, z 401.5 over the stone's origin: our ledge height). A stick jump with no target there leaves after 8.3 frames and ~175 units (as ours, Tuning::stickJumpFrames). Ours checks the jump's target (q43) only at the take-off, against the ledge where it is then, so from 58 back she walks off the end during the 8-frame run-up; how tru.exe's query sees the coming stone early (0x7296C0, the owner velocity 0x7027B0) is not decoded [U] (OU-PZL-012). This route therefore starts its jump 154 back from the end, where ours takes off at the end and the aimed jump catches the stone (the walkthrough: stand at the edge, a stone from the left, jump forward to grab it).
